audits.title: Audit of the Adhd Care Pathway Compliance
audits.standard: Local Trust ADHD pathway based on NICE NG87 (2018): eligibility, assessment, outcome measures, medication initiation and ESCA, risk assessment, safety planning and follow-up
audits.setting: Local ADHD care pathway, North Staffordshire Combined Healthcare NHS Trust

cycle1.result: All met eligibility and had a keyworker. Initial ReQoL 64% (50/78); holistic assessment 88% (69/78); care plans 100% but only 49% with DIALOG and Goal-Based Outcomes; risk assessment 99% (77/78); safety plans 76% (59/78). Medication initiated in 76/78 with ESCA sent for 62; all had 6-monthly reviews.

audits.other_findings: Deprescribing or medication holiday discussions documented in only three cases; four ESCA requests rejected by the same GP practice.
audits.citation: Kaur H, Brace B. Audit of the Adhd Care Pathway Compliance. BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S310-S310. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11683.

audits.title: Management of ADHD in children and adolescents: clinical audit in a South African setting.
audits.standard: 17 audit standards from NICE ADHD guidelines; good compliance ≥80%, fair 50-79%
audits.setting: Central and peripheral clinics, Division of Child & Adolescent Psychiatry, Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, Cape Town

cycle1.result: Compliance low, with only four of 17 standards rated good; physical monitoring especially poor.

audits.other_findings: The central clinic group received more treatment options and safer monitoring; an audit checklist was produced for future cycles.
audits.citation: Vrba K, Vogel W, de Vries PJ. Management of ADHD in children and adolescents: clinical audit in a South African setting. J Child Adolesc Ment Health. 2016;28(1):1-19. doi:10.2989/17280583.2015.1128437. PMID: 27088273.

audits.title: Guideline adherence in the management of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder in children: An audit of selected medical records in three Australian states.
audits.standard: 34 indicators derived from ADHD clinical practice guidelines
audits.setting: 46 GP clinics and 20 paediatric practices in three Australian states

cycle1.result: Overall adherence 83.6%; paediatricians 90.1% versus GPs 68.3% (p = 0.02); appropriate assessment 95.2%.

audits.other_findings: Ongoing review of children on stimulants was low: paediatricians 51.1%, GPs 18.7%.
audits.citation: Ellis LA, Blakely B, Hazell P, Woolfenden S, Hiscock H, Sarkozy V, et al.. Guideline adherence in the management of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder in children: An audit of selected medical records in three Australian states. PLoS One. 2021;16(2):e0245916. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0245916. PMID: 33556083.

audits.title: Management and co-morbidities in children and adolescents with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder diagnosis: A clinical audit in the Eastern Cape province, South Africa.
audits.setting: Neurodevelopmental clinics in paediatric departments of two hospitals, Buffalo City Municipality, Eastern Cape

cycle1.result: 8 of 16 standards over 80% compliance, 2 fair (50-79%), 6 poor.

audits.other_findings: Gaps in psychosocial interventions, caregiver support and structured support groups.
audits.citation: Mpondo S, Vogel W, Michaelis IA. Management and co-morbidities in children and adolescents with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder diagnosis: A clinical audit in the Eastern Cape province, South Africa. S Afr J Psychiatr. 2026;32:2585. doi:10.4102/sajpsychiatry.v32i0.2585. PMID: 41646449.

audits.title: Specialist adult ADHD clinics in East Anglia: service evaluation and audit of NICE guideline compliance
audits.standard: NICE adult ADHD recommendations (adapted ADHD audit support tool)
audits.setting: Two specialist adult ADHD clinics, East Anglia

cycle1.result: Good compliance for diagnosis, assessment and drug treatment; poor transition from CAMHS, underdeveloped comprehensive treatment programmes and deficient physical examinations.

audits.other_findings: Substance use was present in almost half of patients.
audits.citation: Magon R, Latheesh B, Müller U. Specialist adult ADHD clinics in East Anglia: service evaluation and audit of NICE guideline compliance. BJPsych Bulletin. 2015;39(3):136-140. doi:10.1192/pb.bp.113.043257.
